section_heading: How to find housing after a disaster > Get help paying for housing
original_passage: Some Low Income Home Energy Assistance Programs (LIHEAPs) set aside money to help people get shelter after a natural disaster. Each office sets its own criteria for who can receive funds. Contact the LIHEAP office that serves your state. Or contact the LIHEAP office in your tribal area.
